=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _push_targets, lines 456-477 (refspecs = positionals if remote_provided else positionals[1:])
  WHY: When both `--repo=<name>` and an explicit positional remote are provided, the positional remote is incorrectly treated as a refspec. For `git push origin HEAD:feature/x --repo=upstream`, positionals contains ["origin", "HEAD:feature/x"]. With remote_provided=True, refspecs becomes the full positionals list, so "origin" is parsed as a branch/refspec. The guard then calls _branch_ref("origin") and queries pull requests for branch "origin" — a remote name that does not exist as a local branch — producing either a false block or an incorrect uncertain warning. The correct behavior: when a positional remote is present, it remains the remote (not a refspec) regardless of whether --repo is also set. The fix is to track positional-remote presence separately from --repo presence, and only skip positionals[0] when a positional remote was actually consumed.
